item.title: P.O.D. Says It Is “Really Super Proud” of New Album Recorded With Will Yip
item.description: P.O.D. has finished its next studio album, and guitarist Marcos Curiel and bassist Mark “Traa” Daniels sound unusually confident about where the band landed. Speaking in a recent interview with FemMetal, the musicians discussed the follow-up to 2024’s Veritas, their collaboration with producer Will Yip, and an album that appears set to push P.

item.title: THREE DAYS GRACE Releases New Single 'DOMINATE' Ahead Of Upcoming Album
item.description: Three Days Grace has released a new single titled “Dominate” (watch the video at the end of the article), available today on all major streaming platforms. The track is part of the band’s upcoming eighth studio album, Alienation, scheduled for release on August 22, 2025, via RCA Records.

item.title: Meshuggah Drops "Ligature Marks" Music Video Alongside "Immutable - The Indelible Edition" Announcement
item.description: Yep, MESHUGGAH is back to make your speakers beg for mercy—again. Not just playing their usual brand of mind-melting, time-signature-abusing, existential-crisis-inducing metal—oh no, they’ve decided to remaster their already ridiculous 2022 album Immutable and slap on a shiny new title: “Immutable - The Indelible Edition” (because clearly, “Immutable” wasn’t immutable enough).

item.title: Michael Wilton Talks New Queensrÿche Album and 2025 Goals
item.description: Queensrÿche guitarist Michael Wilton spoke with Robert Cavuoto (for MyGlobalMind). Touched on new record plans? Absolutely. Also reflected on the many twists and turns the band has faced over the decades (and there have been plenty).

item.title: Slipknot's Look Outside Your Window Finally Set for 2025 Release
item.description: Slipknot’s Look Outside Your Window is like Bigfoot. Always talked about. Never seen. But now, after nearly 20 years of “soon, we swear,” the album might actually happen.

item.title: Slipknot’s Clown Talks Delays for 'Look Outside Your Window'
item.description: Back in 2024, Shawn “Clown” Crahan of Slipknot confidently announced that the long-teased *Look Outside Your Window* would finally see the light of day this year. Fast forward to November, and here we are: still no album.
